text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Mmh...?! It's spicy...? Even though it's a "French Baguette Sandwich"?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is this the "Ultra Spicy! Habanero Sandwich"?!
I bought it by mistake.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“Still... yeah, maybe this is a good opportunity!
I just don't usually eat it, but it might be delicious.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hauu...
M-My neck... is s-so stiff...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her overly positive attitude backfired, and she ended up feeling out of sorts for a while...
